brief:
Mehdi Hasan and Owen Jones discussed their separate interviews with Russell Brand, according to Zeteo, while taking opposing positions on whether Britain should rejoin the European Union. The two commentators also addressed concerns about Palestinian schoolchildren in the UK and what they characterized as recent attacks on free speech.

The segment covered Brand's statements alongside broader debates about European integration and civil liberties in Britain.
dek: Mehdi Hasan and Owen Jones also debate whether Britain should rejoin the EU – and take very different sides. Plus, Palestinian schoolkids in the UK and the latest outrageous assault on free speech.
title: Hasan and Jones debate Brand interviews, EU membership, free speech
